en.explanation: He also made the consent of both bride and bridegroom compulsory, and attempted to abolish sati.

en.explanation: In 1846 the minimum marriageable age for a girl had been only 10. The Sarda Act of 1930 later fixed 14 for girls and 18 for boys.

en.explanation: Sati prevailed especially among the Rajputs; at first voluntary, it later came to be forced on widows by relatives.
